task.maid_rpg_task.maid_tree.desc: The maid will cut down the logs around her and plant saplings.
task.maid_rpg_task.mage_task.desc: The maid will use elemental magic with a gohei with special habilities she will deal big area or single damage but she will have low health.
task.maid_rpg_task.locate.desc: The maid can locate the some structure or your home with specific items.
task.maid_rpg_task.support.desc: The maid will revive nearby bleeding player and give positive effects for team.
task.maid_rpg_task.dps_task.desc: The maid will deal big damage to enemies but have low health.
task.maid_rpg_task.tank_task.desc: The maid will receive damage for allies and have high health but low damage.
task.maid_rpg_task.master_maid.desc: The maid will combine support and attack roles with high damage output.
item.maid_rpg_task.master_soul_spell.too: Equip in a maid's bauble slot to unlock multi-retract on the Smart Slab.
Right-click a baubled maid with empty slab → retracts up to 4 nearby baubled maids at once.
Shift+right-click a baubled maid (slab full or empty) → retracts that one maid and adds her to the slab, even if others are already inside.
Right-click a block → places all retracted maids at once.
Shift+right-click a block → places only the selected maid.
Hold slab + press Up/Down → cycle through retracted maids.
item.maid_rpg_task.master_soul_spell.no_: No nearby maids with this bauble equipped found
